units.source_text: 黑色之深浅，表示丧服之重轻（参看第九十页注①）。

en.t: The depth of the black color indicated the relative severity of the mourning dress (see note 1 on page 90).

units.source_text: 男女不平等的封建社会里的制度，夫对妻丧服轻，妻对夫丧服重。

en.t: Under the customs of a feudal society in which men and women were unequal, a husband wore lighter mourning for his wife, while a wife wore heavier mourning for her husband.
